Variants.Content: Kuroshio Island is an island in the Iron Islands, connected to the traditional territory of the Kuroshio family. The black tide can not only refer to the shadow of the reef shore, but also fits the reverence of the islanders for the sea: the tide gives them fish, salt and navigation, but it also takes away boats, roofs and relatives in one night. The Kuroshio family retains their beliefs and family memories in Ironborn society, but life on the island is still subject to the same restrictions - poor soil, limited wood, complex waterways, and long winter supplies. Kuroshio Island is not an abstract pirate den, but a community that needs to repair ships, store salt, guard wells, and wait for the weather to improve.
